description: Principal is local administrator on the computer; enables lateral movement to it.

telemetry.detail: Successful network logon (type 3) on the target for SMB/WMI/WinRM movement.
New service installed - fires for PsExec-style movement (the loudest option).
Noise depends entirely on the movement method: token/WinRM is medium, PsExec service creation is high.

abuse_primitive: Lateral movement via WinRM (quieter) / WMI / SMB / PsExec (loudest, 7045).
notes: Score assumes a quieter method (WinRM/WMI). PsExec pushes it toward 55 via Event 7045. AdminTo is the right, not the act - the chosen technique sets the cost.
